answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, slashed if peers prove a fake identity. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake island of sock-puppets separately, so thousands of fakes cost thousands of stakes. Honest agents reach the ivory tier of reputation after a clean history and get deposits back, so one real identity joins cheaply while mass fakery stays ruinously expensive — the cost horizon scales with the attack, not the defence.
